name: poc-microfrontends
description: POC de microfrontends com Vite, React, Tailwind e Module Federation 2.0

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shell,catalog,cart,checkout -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @microstore/shell" "npm run dev -w @microstore/catalog" "npm run dev -w @microstore/cart" "npm run dev -w @microstore/checkout"
scripts.preview: concurrently -n shell,catalog,cart,checkout -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta "npm run preview -w @microstore/shell" "npm run preview -w @microstore/catalog" "npm run preview -w @microstore/cart" "npm run preview -w @microstore/checkout"
